text:
[issue by Vancomb]
ferritecore and Steam Rails are somehow having a stackoverflow with each other. Idk what is triggering it. I right clicked a create window while holding an axe. Thats the only way I am able to replicate it.

[latest (1).log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25422903/latest.1.log)

[crash-2026-02-19_12.05.44-client.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25422904/crash-2026-02-19_12.05.44-client.txt)

[comment by malte0811 (owner)]
As far as I can tell from the log, the mention of FerriteCore is mostly coincidence. The "core" of the stacktrace (the infinitely repeating section, which is what matters in a stack overflow) is purely from Create. Did you report this to them as well?

[comment by Vancomb (none)]
Hey, thanks for responding and for the information. I did report it to them, I am still trying to get to the bottom of it. I guess judging by your response I can rule out FerriteCore.

[comment by VoidLeech (none)]
This is a conflict between Create https://github.com/Creators-of-Create/Create/issues/10012 and Epic Fight https://github.com/Antikythera-Studios/epicfight/issues/2471.

[comment by malte0811 (owner)]
I'll close this then, thank you.
